title: Mie scattering by a sphere (3D)
description: Scattering and extinction efficiencies of a dielectric sphere from the Mie series (pp.em.mie): against the published BHMIE sample of Bohren & Huffman, the Rayleigh law for small spheres, the optical theorem (extinction from the forward amplitude) and the extinction paradox Q_ext -> 2 for large spheres.
